edges.reason: Constructor takes the caller controlled msg.sender as the owner identity.
Constructor writes the caller address into the privileged _owner state variable.
Constructor invokes _mint to create the genesis supply.
initialSupply is passed as the mint amount argument.
isOwner reads the privileged _owner state variable.
isOwner compares the untrusted msg.sender against _owner to authorise access.
onlyOwner modifier delegates the access decision to isOwner.
onlyOwner guards the approve function.
onlyOwner guards the allowance function.
onlyOwner guards the increaseAllowance function.
onlyOwner guards the decreaseAllowance function.
balanceOf reads the requested account from the _balances mapping.
transfer forwards the untrusted msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer delegates the balance update to _transfer.
transferFrom uses the untrusted msg.sender as the spender key for the allowance lookup.
transferFrom reads _allowed[from][msg.sender] for the allowance check.
transferFrom feeds the allowance value into the unchecked subtraction of the spender allowance.
The unchecked subtraction writes the reduced allowance back into _allowed.
transferFrom delegates the actual balance movement to _transfer after the allowance check.
approve keys the allowance on the untrusted msg.sender and is onlyOwner guarded.
approve writes the granted amount into _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
increaseAllowance keys the allowance update on the untrusted msg.sender and is onlyOwner guarded.
increaseAllowance performs an unchecked additive update of the stored allowance.
The unchecked addition result is stored back into _allowed.
decreaseAllowance keys the allowance update on the untrusted msg.sender and is onlyOwner guarded.
decreaseAllowance performs an unchecked subtractive update of the stored allowance.
The unchecked subtraction result is stored back into _allowed.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping for both accounts.
_transfer applies an unchecked subtraction to the sender balance.
The unchecked sender balance deduction is persisted in _balances.
_transfer applies an unchecked addition to the recipient balance.
The unchecked recipient balance credit is persisted in _balances.
_mint assigns the supplied amount directly to the account balance in _balances.
_mint overwrites the totalSupply state variable.
